import currency

balances = Hash(default_value=0)
operator = Variable()
distributionAmount = Variable()
chipsValue = Variable()
symbol = Variable()

@construct
def seed(vk: str, chips_value: int):
    balances[vk] = 10000000000
    symbol.set('GIFI')
    chipsValue.set(chips_value)    
    balances["chips_in_table"] = 0
    balances["last_withdraw"] = 0
    balances["big_win"] = 0  
    operator.set(vk)
    distributionAmount.set(0)


@export
def buy_chips(amount: float):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    account = ctx.caller
    pool = operator.get()

    new_amount = amount * chipsValue.get()
    assert balances[pool] >= new_amount, 'Not enough chips to send!'
 
    currency.transfer_from(amount, pool, account)
    balances[pool] -= new_amount
    balances[account] += new_amount
    balances["chips_in_table"] += new_amount
    
@export
def set_winner_hand(amount:float, account: str, blackjack: bool):
    assert_owner()

    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    pool = operator.get()

    assert balances[pool] >= amount, 'Not enough chips to send!'

    balances[pool] -= amount
    balances[account] += amount  
    balances["chips_in_table"] += amount

    if blackjack is True:
        balances[account, 'blackjack_hands'] += 1 
        
    balances[account, 'winner_hands'] += 1

    if balances[account, 'plays_count'] is not None:
        winratio = ((balances[account, 'winner_hands'] * 100) / balances[account,'plays_count']) 
    else:
        winratio = '0'
                   
    winratio = '{:.2f}'.format(winratio)
    balances[account, 'win_ratio'] = winratio

@export
def tie_hand(amount:float, account: str):
    assert_owner()

    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    pool = operator.get()
    assert balances[pool] >= amount, 'Not enough chips to send!'

    balances[pool] -= amount
    balances[account] += amount  
    balances["chips_in_table"] += amount
 
@export
def set_loser_hand(account: str):
    assert_owner()

    if balances[account, 'plays_count'] is not None:
        winratio = ((balances[account, 'winner_hands'] * 100) / balances[account,'plays_count']) 
    else:
        winratio = '0'

    winratio = '{:.2f}'.format(winratio)
    balances[account, 'win_ratio'] = winratio

@export
def bet(amount: float, account: str):
    assert_owner()  
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'    
    pool = operator.get()   
    assert balances[account] >= amount, 'Not enough chips to send!'
    
    balances[account] -= amount
    balances[pool] += amount
    balances["chips_in_table"] -= amount
    balances[account, 'plays_count'] += 1    

@export
def bet_self(amount: float):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    sender = ctx.caller
    pool = operator.get()
    assert balances[sender] >= amount, 'Not enough chips to send!'

    balances[sender] -= amount
    balances[pool] += amount
    balances["chips_in_table"] -= amount
    balances[sender, 'plays_count'] += 1    

    
@export
def pay(amount: float, account: str):
    assert_owner()
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    sender = operator.get()
    assert balances[account] >= amount, 'Not enough chips to send!'
  
    total_balance = amount / chipsValue.get()
    currency.transfer_from(total_balance *  decimal('0.98'), account, sender)
    
    balances[account] -= amount   
    balances[sender] += amount
    balances["chips_in_table"] -= amount
    balances["last_withdraw"] = total_balance
    distributionAmount.set(distributionAmount.get() + total_balance)


@export
def pay_self(porcent: float):
    assert porcent > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    assert porcent <= 100, 'Max send 100% of your balances!'
    account = ctx.caller
    sender = operator.get()

    amount = balances[account] * (porcent/100)    
    assert balances[account] >= amount, 'Not enough chips to send!'
  
    total_balance = amount / chipsValue.get()
    currency.transfer_from(total_balance *  decimal('0.98'), account, sender)

    balances[account] -= amount
    balances[sender] += amount

    balances["chips_in_table"] -= amount
    balances["last_withdraw"] = total_balance
    distributionAmount.set(distributionAmount.get() + total_balance)

@export
def transfer(amount: float, to: str):
    sender = ctx.caller
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'    
    assert balances[sender] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send!'

    
    balances[sender] -= amount
    balances[to] += amount


@export
def withdrawFees(receiver: str):
    assert_owner()
    BASE = 80
    sender = operator.get()
    in_table = balances["chips_in_table"] / chipsValue.get()
    availableToWithdraw = currency.balance_of(sender) - (in_table + BASE)
    
    assert availableToWithdraw > 0, 'Not enough funds for fee withdrawal. Available Fees ' + availableToWithdraw
    currency.transfer_from(availableToWithdraw *  decimal('0.98'), receiver, sender)


@export
def balance_of(account: str):
    return balances[account]

@export
def allowance(owner: str, spender: str):
    return balances[owner, spender]

@export
def approve(amount: float, to: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    sender = ctx.caller
    balances[sender, to] += amount
    return balances[sender, to]

@export
def change_value(value: float):
    assert_owner()
    assert value > 0, 'Cannot send negative value!'
    chipsValue.set(value)
    
def assert_owner():
    assert ctx.caller == operator.get(), 'Only operator can call!'
